input.summary: Preserve a one-run instrumentation pilot that records a single cubic flow completion time under fixed emulated conditions (10 ms delay, 100 Mbit/s, 125 KB buffer, 1 MB file). The wider claim—that adding 20 ms delay changes TCP flow completion time—remains unresolved. No population inference, causal finding, or monetary charge is asserted.
questions: Can the frozen emulated runner record one cubic flow completion time with a retained observation identity?

proposal.problem: Verify the measurement path before a separate matched delay-comparison campaign.
proposal.question: Can the frozen emulated runner record one cubic flow completion time with a retained observation identity?
proposal.hypothesis: Under fixed emulated bottleneck conditions, adding 20 ms delay changes TCP flow completion time.
proposal.conditions: One 1 MB cubic flow with 10 ms delay, 100 Mbit/s bottleneck and 125 KB buffer in emulated-netem-v1.
proposal.related_work: No novelty or full-text literature review is asserted; original claim/source metadata and hashes are retained.
proposal.alternatives: A runner or instrumentation defect can prevent observation; successful recording alone does not validate the delay claim.
proposal.design: Run the one frozen configuration once and preserve the completion-time observation and exact identifiers.
proposal.metrics: flow_completion_time_ms in ms; finite nonnegative record, with no published numeric target.
proposal.controls: One frozen configuration and one flow; verify exact configuration and input hash before execution.
proposal.falsification: Missing or invalid completion time fails this instrumentation check. This pilot cannot confirm or refute the wider 20 ms comparison.
proposal.inputs: The fixed built-in runner configuration and source hashes are supplied; no external dataset or credentials are required for planning. Execution needs an enabled runner.
proposal.limitations: Instrumentation feasibility only. No claim about the 20 ms comparison, causality, real-world performance or generalization is resolved.

protocol.hypotheses: Under fixed emulated bottleneck conditions, adding 20 ms delay changes TCP flow completion time.
questions: Can the frozen emulated runner record one cubic flow completion time with a retained observation identity?
protocol.dates_or_epochs: Prospective execution after protocol freeze; retain actual UTC timestamps and runner revisions.
protocol.replication_unit: One complete emulated invocation; no independent population replication is asserted.
protocol.sample_size_rationale: One run verifies recording feasibility only; no comparison or population inference is attempted.
protocol.exclusions: Configuration or input identity mismatch fails the attempt; retain all failures.
protocol.missing_data: Absent completion time is missing, invalid values remain invalid, and a recorded zero is not imputed or silently excluded.
protocol.statistics: Report the single completion time in ms and run status; no comparison estimate or inferential interval.
protocol.dependence: One shared emulated host; no independent sampling or population uncertainty is asserted.
protocol.stopping_rule: Stop after this one frozen invocation or its wall deadline; preserve failed outcomes without automatic retries.
protocol.prior_exposure: Synthetic development case exposed to the implementing AI; no held-out validation or new networking outcome asserted.
protocol.coverage_limits: Instrumentation feasibility only. No claim about the 20 ms comparison, causality, real-world performance or generalization is resolved.
algorithms: emulated-netem-v1, netem_cubic_benchmark_nines.py; cubic; record actual runtime versions
controls: One frozen configuration and one flow; verify exact configuration and input hash before execution

seeds.rationale: No randomized assignment or stochastic analysis in this one-run instrumentation pilot.

sensitivity.rationale: This instrumentation pilot records one configuration; sensitivity to delay requires a separate matched campaign.

metrics.name: flow_completion_time_ms
metrics.criterion: Record finite nonnegative completion time with run and configuration identity; no broad claim finding.

resource_limits.cost_basis: Actual cloud hosting charges unknown; configured limits are not measured costs.
